subject: Acme procurement: procurement readiness & commercial path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps (procurement readiness)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on the procurement path: 

Call recap:
- Confirmed high-level use case (multi-region inference for customer support workflows).
- Target go-live: Q4 2026 (pilot leading to phased rollout).
- Primary procurement path: Acme prefers PO for production contracts; card ok for pilot if you need to move quickly.

Open items / asks from Acme (per the call):
1) Procurement questionnaire (procurement team) — we should get this back to understand compliance checkpoints.
2) SOW or purchase order owner — who will sign on your side?
3) Any marketplace interest (AWS Marketplace / Azure) or do you prefer direct vendor contract?

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll send a draft SOW and our standard procurement questionnaire (attached). Please indicate whether your procurement team prefers a PO or card for pilot.
- Rishi (acct exec) to coordinate pricing options for pilot vs committed Dedicated capacity.
- Neha (legal) on standby for any redlines.

Attachments: Acme_Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW), procurement_questionnaire.xlsx

Would love a reply by end of week with who on your team will own the PO and whether you’re interested in Marketplace listing. Happy to hop on a short follow-up with procurement if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform

From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps (procurement readiness)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Quick answers from procurement: 

- We generally do PO for production contracts. For a short pilot (under $10k) we can pay by corporate card to accelerate if Redwood can accept that.
- I’m attaching our completed procurement questionnaire — procurement_questionnaire.xlsx (completed).
- Signer for SOW/contract: Tom Nguyen (Senior Procurement Manager). He’s looped here.
- Marketplace: we have an internal preference for marketplace listings for easier vendor onboarding long-term, but that’s not a blocker for us. If you can support both, that would be ideal.

Next steps on our side: I’ll route the questionnaire to procurement legal for a quick review and aim to get a PO template back by next Wednesday (29 Jul). If card payment is needed to start pilot earlier, let me know and I’ll see if we can approve a one-time card payment.

Sarah
Sarah Patel
Procurement Lead, Acme Corp
Sarah.Patel@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0147

Attachment: procurement_questionnaire.xlsx (completed)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme procurement: commercial path (PO vs card) / next steps

Rishi / Neha —

Looping you in on the procurement thread with Acme. Highlights: Sarah returned the questionnaire (attached) and confirms Acme prefers PO for production; card possible for small pilot. Tom Nguyen will be signer. They’re also interested in a Marketplace listing long-term.

Asks:
- Rishi: can you put together two pricing options for Tom — (A) pilot (card-friendly, month-to-month, cap at $8k) and (B) committed Dedicated (12-month, PO, discounted rate). I’ll share the draft SOW with him once pricing is ready.
- Neha: please review the attached draft SOW (Acme_Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf) and flag any clauses that typically get redlined by procurement teams (payment terms, data residency, SLAs). If we should preemptively tweak anything for Acme’s profile, let me know.

Timing: Acme indicated they’ll try to return a PO template by 29 Jul. If we don’t have a PO by then, Sarah said card for pilot may be possible — we should be prepared to accept card to keep momentum.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the SOW send once pricing is in.

-Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly check-in: where is the PO / card approval?

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Quick weekly check-in to see where things are on your side and whether there’s anything we can unblock: 

- Did procurement legal have any follow-ups from the questionnaire?
- Any timeline on the PO template or signer confirmation from Tom?
- If you prefer to start with a pilot on card, we can accept card and spin up a pilot environment in 2 business days — just need confirmation and payment details.

To make it easier I’ve re-attached the draft SOW here and added a DocuSign link if you’d like to sign digitally: https://www.docusign.com/abc123-acme-sow

If it helps, I’m also available for a 20-minute call with procurement/legal to walk through any SOW clauses. Please let me know what works this week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
